measurement_policy: Original thresholds and automated screens retained. Manual observations are separate; no decks, rules or pilot changes.

evidence: Mortify removed GGS at own turn3; reentered turn6 and first Dragon turn9. Fumigate and Fell the Mighty later interrupted development.
At global turn51 / own turn13, two GGS Dragon tokens (IDs496,535) each dealt5 combat damage to Gabe_Food, whose life fell5 to-5.
GGS attacked in the same combat, received4 damage from three blockers, went to graveyard/command, and was recast in main2 using ten logged mana-source activations.
Every recorded own COMBAT_BEGIN from turns13 through18 had GGS present and fresh_ready=0. No later GGS Dragon creation was observed.
reviews.interpretation: The fixed15/20 pressure threshold missed an actual opponent elimination. This game is not evidence of insufficient natural Dragon payoff. Early disruption/recovery was costly, but terminal lack of fresh attack-ready creatures is a separate ammunition observation. The commander attack/recast is a pilot-risk example; its tactical necessity is not proven.
reviews.limits: No replayed alternative line; no causal claim that another card or withholding GGS would win the game.
